scope: Miao Chapter 14 (pp. 455-508): the Ramsey model (decentralisations, Proposition 14.1.1, steady state, saddle path) and fiscal policy, the basic RBC model (planner and competitive equilibrium, steady state, log-linearised system, saddle path), utility functions (KPR, GHH, indivisible labour), capacity utilisation, capital and investment adjustment costs (Proposition 14.3.1), stochastic trends, and the mathematical content of Exercises 1-7.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 14
